cases.yaml:
# Diary Companion portable defaults

llm:
  # Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Override for your provider.
  base_url: http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1
  api_key: ""
  chat_model: default
  embed_model: default
  aux:
    base_url: http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1
    api_key: ""
    model: default
  timeout_s: 300
  max_retries: 3
  # Token cap of each companion answer (#127); a longer answer is cut off and marked as shortened.
  max_answer_tokens: 1024

corpus:
  # Daily files are stored as Entries/YYYY/Month/Month D, YYYY.md.
  # Set to monthly for compatibility with older single-file-per-month corpora.
  entry_layout: daily
  entries_prefix: Entries
  # Local storage works on a clean installation; select webdav explicitly for remote storage.
  backend: local
  root: ""
  local:
    root: data/corpus
  webdav:
    base_url: https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/username/
    username: ""
    timeout_s: 60
  # S3-compatible object storage (MinIO, Backblaze B2, AWS S3, Garage, ...).
  # Path-style addressing; credentials optional (unsigned mode for public buckets).
  s3:
    endpoint_url: ""
    bucket: ""
    access_key: ""
    secret_key: ""
    session_token: ""
    region: us-east-1
    prefix: ""
    timeout_s: 60
  monthly_prefix: ""
  month_file_template: "{year}-{month02}.md"
  index_enabled: false
  index_file: INDEX.md
  redact_markers: true

retrieval:
  db_path: data/index.db
  top_k: 8
  max_context_tokens: 5200
  min_score: 0.30
  # services#116: lexical check of the hits against names and time anchors in the message (README).
  entity_focus: true
  # below_margin: drop hits naming no asked entity that score more than this below the best exact-name hit.
  entity_focus_margin: 0.05
  # services#114: drop hits scoring more than this below the best hit, for messages naming no entity (the entity
  # focus decides otherwise). A number in (0, 1], or off. Off until a full gate run measures it (0.08 suggested).
  score_gap: off

context:
  max_today_tokens: 4500
  max_standing_tokens: 2200
  # Used only when semantic retrieval yields no matches or is unavailable.
  direct_past_days: 3
  max_direct_past_tokens: 1200

ui:
  host: 0.0.0.0
  port: 8010
  title: "Diary Companion"
  # Set DIARY_AUTH_TOKEN before exposing this service beyond a trusted machine.
  auth_token: ""

logging:
  level: INFO
  file: data/agent.log
